system_instructions.role: Expert motivational copywriter and visual-storyboard artist
system_instructions.task_description: Produce a ~2-minute motivational speech (approximately 220–260 words) divided into coherent scenes, formatted as structured JSON that will be rendered by Remotion.
constraints: Scene 1 — Hook: immediately engage the viewer with the central {{topic}}.
Scenes 2 to 8/9 — Development (4–5 scenes): deeply explore the theme, evoke emotion, and build momentum.
Final Scene — Uplift: leave the viewer with a clear, energizing call to improve their life.
Each scene must contain a voiceover_text written in {{language}} and an image_prompt written in English.
image_prompt must be richly detailed, photorealistic, and visually capture the scene's message.
Maintain a consistent color palette, lighting style and overall aesthetic across every image to ensure harmony.
Avoid any mention or depiction of violence, gore, nudity, or other potentially NSFW elements.
Do NOT include markdown, explanations, or text outside the JSON.
system_instructions.critical_instruction: Return ONLY valid JSON matching output_schema. The voiceover_text must be in {{language}}. The image_prompt must ALWAYS be in English, photorealistic, and safe for AI image generation.

scenes.durationInSeconds: number (estimated from voiceover_text length / 2.5 words per second)

style_guide.pacing: measured, with short punchy sentences alternating with reflective longer ones
style_guide.hook_style: direct address to the viewer, immediately naming the central {{topic}} and its emotional weight
style_guide.sentence_style: short declarative sentences, second-person address ('you'), strategic repetition for emphasis
style_guide.emotional_tone: starts with tension or struggle, builds momentum, ends with hope and agency
style_guide.point_of_view: second-person narrator speaking directly to the viewer
style_guide.audience_addressing_style: direct, intimate, as if speaking to one person
visual_cue_prompts: lone figure walking toward a horizon
hands releasing something into the wind
close-up of a determined face in soft light
avoid: generic 'you can do it' clichés without imagery
unrealistic promises or guarantees of success

scenes.voiceover_text: There is a voice inside you that has been waiting. It has been waiting for the noise to stop. For the doubt to quiet down. For you to finally listen.
scenes.image_prompt: Photorealistic close-up of a young person sitting alone on a rooftop at dawn, soft golden light, city blurred in the background, contemplative expression, cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field

scenes.voiceover_text: For years, you have told yourself you are not ready. Not qualified. Not enough. But that voice was never the truth. It was a habit.
scenes.image_prompt: Photorealistic image of a person looking into a mirror in a dimly lit room, reflection slightly out of focus, warm morning light entering from a window, cinematic mood

scenes.voiceover_text: Every great thing you have ever done began the same way — with a decision made before you felt ready. Before you had permission. Before you were certain.
scenes.image_prompt: Photorealistic shot of a person standing at the edge of a cliff at sunrise, arms at their sides, facing a vast open valley, golden light, cinematic composition, sense of scale

scenes.voiceover_text: The people you admire are not fearless. They are simply more familiar with the discomfort of starting. They have learned to move before the fear finishes its sentence.
scenes.image_prompt: Photorealistic portrait of a determined middle-aged person walking through a busy city street at dusk, blurred crowds on both sides, focused expression, cinematic warm lighting

scenes.voiceover_text: You do not need to become someone else. You need to stop abandoning the person you already are, every time doubt raises its voice.
scenes.image_prompt: Photorealistic image of hands opening to release a small paper boat into a calm river at sunrise, warm light, soft focus background, cinematic and serene

scenes.voiceover_text: The cost of listening to doubt is not failure. The cost is the quiet life you never lived. The version of you that never got to exist.
scenes.image_prompt: Photorealistic image of an empty chair on a wooden porch facing a vast mountain range at golden hour, soft haze, cinematic depth, sense of longing

scenes.voiceover_text: So start small. Start today. Start with the thing you have been avoiding. Not because you are ready, but because waiting has never once made anyone ready.
scenes.image_prompt: Photorealistic close-up of a single foot stepping onto a wooden floor, warm morning light spilling across the frame, cinematic shallow depth of field

scenes.voiceover_text: The voice that has been waiting inside you is not loud. It does not need to be. It only needs to be heard once — and then acted upon.
scenes.image_prompt: Photorealistic image of a person standing alone on a wide open field at sunset, arms relaxed, facing the horizon, warm golden light, cinematic wide shot

scenes.voiceover_text: Every day you delay, the voice grows quieter. Not because it is weaker, but because you have taught yourself to stop hearing it.
scenes.image_prompt: Photorealistic image of a dimly lit room with a single window, dust particles floating in a beam of sunlight, empty chair facing the window, cinematic and introspective

scenes.voiceover_text: So listen. Today. Not tomorrow. Not when you feel ready. Today. Because the life you are waiting for is waiting for you to begin it. And it always has been.
scenes.image_prompt: Photorealistic image of a lone figure walking confidently toward a bright horizon at sunrise, vast open landscape, warm golden light, cinematic composition, sense of beginning

must_include: consistent visual aesthetic across all image_prompts
must_avoid: explanations or introductions outside the JSON
NSFW, violent, gory, or nudity-related content in image_prompt
voiceover_text in English when {{language}} is not English
generation_instructions.success_condition: The JSON parses cleanly against output_schema, contains 9–10 scenes, the emotional arc moves from tension to uplift, and all image_prompts share a consistent visual identity suitable for a single Remotion render.
generation_instructions.length_requirement: Total voiceover_text across all scenes must sum to approximately 220–260 words.

remotion_mapping.input_props: The entire output_schema JSON is passed as inputProps to the composition.
remotion_mapping.calculate_metadata: durationInFrames = sum(scene.durationInSeconds * fps). The composition uses calculateMetadata to derive the total duration from the scenes array.
assets_pipeline: image_prompt is sent to the image generation provider (FLUX, DALL-E, etc.) to produce a still per scene.
voiceover_text is sent to the TTS provider (ElevenLabs, OpenAI TTS, etc.) to produce one audio file per scene.
Both assets are passed to Remotion via props (imageUrl, audioUrl) alongside the scene metadata.
